title: Multidisciplinary pain plan documentation-only

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports a clinician-entered, patient-discussed perioperative pain plan and communication without medicine names, dose, or taper instructions.
user_facing_items.population: People undergoing surgery, including people with chronic pain or preoperative opioid use.
user_facing_items.setting: Preoperative assessment, perioperative planning, PACU, discharge, pain service, and follow-up.
restrictions: Exact for documenting chronic pain, current opioid use, medicine and psychosocial or substance history, functional pain assessment, clinician-entered perioperative plan, complex pain review, discharge communication, and pain-service follow-up. Medication changes, doses, and tapering are not mapped; scheduled review is overdue.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports a patient-discussed clinician-entered perioperative pain plan for multidisciplinary pain plan documentation; no decision is generated.
